summary: This is an 8-K filed by Community West Bancshares reporting Q1 2026 earnings results and declaring a $0.12 per share cash dividend. The filing includes Item 2.02 (Results of Operations) with a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1, and Item 8.01 (Other Events) noting the dividend declaration. While the press release references a completed merger with United Security Bancshares on April 1, 2026, that merger is a past event, not the subject of this filing. This 8-K is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring.
